architecture: Vue 3 frontend and FastAPI backend in separate containers
public_intent: Restore the frontend's ability to load account data from the backend.

injected_fault.description: The backend CORS middleware allows the retired Vite development origin http://127.0.0.1:5173 instead of the frozen frontend origin http://127.0.0.1:8080.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: The backend returns account JSON, but browser fetch from the supplied frontend is blocked because the expected Access-Control-Allow-Origin response header is absent.

success_rule: All evaluator-only CORS contract, architecture, direct API, Compose health, and Chromium checks pass against the frozen final state.
architectural_invariants: The exact frontend origin http://127.0.0.1:8080 is allowed by the backend.
A wildcard Access-Control-Allow-Origin policy is rejected.
The stale origin http://127.0.0.1:5173 and unrelated origins are not allowed.
The backend account endpoint continues to return the frozen JSON contract.
The Vue frontend continues to fetch the backend at http://127.0.0.1:8000 and does not introduce a proxy or hard-coded account fallback.
Frontend and backend remain separate services.
The agent does not modify evaluator-only tests or evaluator metadata.

oracle.type: researcher-authored backend policy replacement plus auditable unified diff
